content.short: iden3 is a self-sovereign privacy protocol in Web3.
content.description: Originating on Ethereum, Iden3 stands among the frontiers of decentralized privacy. It uses zk-SNARKs as a proven privacy tool, supporting on-chain activity with enhanced privacy. Its native naming service enables identities to transact and interact while maintaining greater anonymity across actions. The project began on Ethereum and is expanding to layer-2 solutions to improve accessibility and scalability across networks, broadening Web3 participation without compromising privacy.
